title: Abduction
description: A young man (Taylor Lautner) must run for his life soon after learning that the folks who raised him are not his real parents.

title: Divergent
description: In a future society, people are divided into factions based on their personalities. After a young woman (Shailene Woodley) learns she is a Divergent and will never fit into any one group, she uncovers a conspiracy to destroy all those like her.

title: Two Night Stand
description: An online hook-up turns into something more after a snowstorm traps two lovers in one's New York apartment.

title: Before We Go
description: A chance encounter between two strangers (Chris Evans, Alice Eve) in Grand Central Terminal sparks a life-changing, nighttime sojourn through New York City.

title: Just Before I Go
description: A man travels back to his hometown to make amends before he gives up on life.

title: Silver Linings Playbook
description: An unexpected bond begins to form between a man trying to rebuild his life and a young woman promising to help him reunite with his estranged wife.

title: The Turkey Bowl
description: A man is pulled back to his rural hometown by his high school buddies on Thanksgiving to finish the Turkey Bowl - a football game against their cross-town rivals that was snowed out 15 years prior.

title: Moonshine
description:
S02 E01 — The Three Sisters of Fate
When a mysterious package arrives at the Moonshine, it makes the Finley-Cullens question their fates and whether the road to their destinies begins -- or end -- at the Moonshine.

title: Moonshine
description:
S02 E02 — Moose Knuckle & The Golden Clam
Rhian and Lidia are determined to get the Moonshine into the Foxton Cove Business Association, even if it means sucking up to an old high school frenemy at the Moonshine's annual Lobsterpalooza event.

title: Moonshine

title: Moonshine
description:

description:

title: Moonshine
description:
S02 E06 — Mommy Issues
The Finley-Cullens kidnap Lidia to make her see reason; at Moonshine, Daniel, Lidia's ex, has a strange bond with motorcyclist Gale.

title: Moonshine
description:
S02 E07 — 44.6304N 64.0515W
As Lidia's plans to break up with Gale go down the drain, a shocked Sammy meets his birth parents.

title: Moonshine
